title: Nieuwland numbers of 175 convex polyhedra, proved in Lean
description:
Lean 4 proofs, built on Mathlib, that decide Rupertness for 175 convex polyhedra (151 Rupert, 24 Noperts) and give each its exact Nieuwland number ν: all 5 Platonic, 13 Archimedean, 13 Catalan, and 92 Johnson solids, prisms, antiprisms, their duals, nine triakis tetrahedra, and seven others. For each Rupert solid, Lean proves that ν is the only root of a rational polynomial system in a rational box, that a pose given by the same root fits weakly at scale ν, and that no larger copy fits. For each Nopert, Lean proves that no copy fits, so ν = 1.

Files:

  • nopert-nieuwland-lean-1.0.zip: the repository (github.com/bence-hervay/nopert-nieuwland-lean) at this version: the definitions, the shared library, each solid's statements and proofs, the scripts, and the explorer. Its README.md says what is proved and how to check it.
  • certificates.zip: each solid's certificate, one certificates/<Family>.<Solid>.tar.xz per solid, the same files as the GitHub release certificates (over 50 GB of Lean unpacked). Each piece's size and SHA-256 are in the solid's Certificates/manifest.json.
  • SHA256SUMS: the SHA-256 of both zips and of every archive inside certificates.zip.

To check a solid from this record: unpack both zips in one folder, then, in nopert-nieuwland-lean-1.0/, run python3 scripts/check.py Polyhedra/Platonic/Cube --jobs 4 --source ../certificates.

The interactive explorer: bence.io/nieuwland-explorer.
